module: Base class of the flowgraph manager's modules (the "modules" attached to the manager, as opposed to nodes). It defines a class C with empty hooks (clear, onUpdate, executionStarted, executionStopped) that derived modules override. The file is not a usable extension on its own: it is used by flowgraph modules via M.use(mgr, derivedClass).
notes: C.moduleOrder = 0: module processing order, lower values come first.
C.hooks is an empty table, meant to declare the hooks handled by the module.
The preTrigger/afterTrigger functions are commented out in the code (not available).
M.use calls o:init() a second time only if the derived class redefined init (without the mgr argument in that case).

createBase.desc: Creates an instance of the base class: a table with C as metatable, then calls init(...) (so init(mgr)).

....desc: arguments passed to init, normally the flowgraph manager mgr

use.desc: Creates a base module, copies all fields/methods of derivedClass onto it (override), then calls init() again if the derived class redefined it.

mgr.desc: flowgraph manager that owns the module

derivedClass.desc: table of methods/fields that replace those of the base

C.desc: Base class of a flowgraph module. The empty methods are meant to be overridden.

clear.desc: Empty hook "usable" by derived modules to clear their state.

onUpdate.desc: Empty hook called on every manager update (overridden by modules).

executionStopped.desc: Empty hook called when the flowgraph execution stops.

executionStarted.desc: Empty hook called when the flowgraph execution starts.

onClear.desc: Calls self:executionStopped(). Serves as the reaction to the manager being cleared.
